cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: the paved square before a city gate tower — carries her keepsake low at her side; the moat path beneath the old Jingzhou city wall at dusk — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a quiet library reading room with tall bookshelves — holds a magnifying glass by its handle at chest height; a Peking opera dressing room — standing at a work surface; a lantern-lit old-town street at night — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a scholar's study stacked with bound bamboo slips — lifts a small storage box onto the shelf above her; a domed marble hammam with warm stone slabs and brass bowls — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; a beach club of white daybeds and parasols on the sand — sitting on the ground; the still surface of a wide lotus lake in morning mist — standing and leaning her upper body forward toward the camera from the hips; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — crouches low with a camera raised to her eye; an old Chengdu teahouse with bamboo chairs — grinds the ink stick on a calligraphy brush and an ink stone; the lounge of an airship gondola — seated on a chair
